importantFindings: Ranger Tugs' own archive cleanly separates current and past named variants, supporting searchable historical identities without inventing model splits.
The 2026 R-27 is now twin-outboard; it remains distinct from the prior single-outboard R-27 NW/LE record.
R-43 Sedan and Command Bridge use twin Volvo IPS pod drives and therefore require pod-drive propulsion rather than shaft classification.
Cutwater 30 Command Bridge is explicitly the same underlying boat as the 30 Sedan with a retractable flybridge.
C-Dory 26 Pro Angler is a real historical model: owner evidence includes a 2005 hull with HIN CD026021I405. Earlier suspicion that the model might be fictitious is withdrawn.
C-Dory TomCat 255 is correctly normalized as a power catamaran rather than monohull.
American Tug's own company history treats the founding model as the AT 34/365 lineage; both designations remain searchable but are linked.
Rosborough RF-246 Wheelhouse and Sedan are configurations of the same modified-V fiberglass hull; propulsion varied from sterndrives to single/twin outboards, so no universal propulsion is forced.
